THE WORK

Carry your part.

01 / DISCIPLINE

Own the week.

Mouth. Body. Word. Keep the small rule before you ask anyone to trust the big promise.

02 / LEADERSHIP

Keep the call.

Listen, then decide. Take counsel. You answer for the house.

03 / BROTHERHOOD

Do not hand
her the fire.

Brothers get the fear. She gets a plan. Tell the truth, get counsel, and carry the decision home.

FATHERHOOD

The boy copies
your night.

What you do after work teaches him. Your phone. Your temper. Your word to his mother.

Give him something worth repeating.

You will stand there when God asks who ran it.
